text_block_list.text:
After running through today's practice
schedule, I
decide to call it a day when
Кинг Хало protests.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
This amount of practice is simply
insufficient!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
I can't just do what everyone else does if
I want to
prove that I'm a first-rate
Umamusume.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
I must tackle even routine training with
more
effort and passion than anyone
else.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
That's why we're adding on extra
training! You
must make certain I'm in
top form!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало
choice_data_list:
First-rate runners also have to know when to
call it a day.

text_block_list.text: Hehe! That's what I like to hear!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
That's precisely why you're my trainer.
Now I'm
bursting with energy and ready
to go!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Urk... "When to call it a day," huh?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
It's true... Pushing yourself so hard you
get sick is
certainly not first-rate...
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
So you're saying that the most important
thing to
do is...
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
To stay in top condition so I can always
give one
hundred percent?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: In that case, I suppose I can accept this.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
I'll rest up and not overdo it... All for the
sake of
continuing my first-rate reign!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
I give Кинг Хало all the training she can
handle.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
After we talk it out, Кинг Хало decides
to refrain
from extra training.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
